messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2072509999 opened by monitoring — latency SLOs breached in eu-west. p95 spiking from 180ms -> 850ms, p99 > 2.5s. Streaming sessions reporting stalls. Auto-incident created and paging team.

asha (SRE): Ack. I'm on it. Seeing a big uptick in cache miss-rate for prefix-cache shards. 1min miss-rate jumped from 4% -> 37% for prefix-hash group B.

ben (Infra): Repro dashboard: https://dash.redwood.company/boards/latency?view=eu-west — noticed correlated increase in downstream paging to cold storage. Paging requests/sec from kvstore up 4x.

carla (ML Infra): Streaming workers showing repeated tail retries, logs include "kv-get-miss -> fetch-from-origin -> stream-delay 2000ms".

jordan (oncall): Paging the dedicated infra channel and alerting customers with impacted SLAs. Current mitigation: can we route traffic to older prefix-hash variant? That had higher hit rate.

asha (SRE): We rolled a prefix-hash change in the last deploy at 2072508000 for even distribution. Looks like hash function change increased key entropy for small prefixes and blew out local shard caches. Patch below:

commit: a1b2c3d4
change: prefix-hash v2 -> v3
reason: reduce hotspotting

ben (Infra): Confirmed: shard-local cache occupancy dropped 60% after rollout. KV client metrics show increased cross-shard fetches.

ops-support: Customers: two high-traffic apps showing degraded streaming; CS already notified. No P1 yet but SLOs are failing.

carla (ML Infra): Quick check: can we enable KV client-side read-through caching fallback to previous hash layout? Might be nontrivial.

asha (SRE): Fast mitigation plan: 1) Pause traffic to rollout group v3 (routing) 2) Revert prefix-hash to v2 on a small canary cluster 3) Warm caches by replaying recent prefixes via prefetch script. Will coordinate.

jordan (oncall): I'm switching traffic away from v3 to v2-compatible nodes for eu-west. Actioning route override now.

ben (Infra): Route override applied: traffic ratio 70% -> v2-compatible nodes. Observability: p95 dropped to 340ms in 2m. p99 still noisy ~1.6s.

asha (SRE): Launching cache-warmup job for hotspots. Script:

# warmup recent prefixes
python tools/warm_prefixes.py --lookback 10m --concurrency 16 --target shards:v2

carla (ML Infra): Started warmup. Prefetch QPS ~1200, CPU on canary nodes spiked but within limit. Streaming stalls reduced; p99 trending down.

ops-support: Notifying impacted customers that we have a mitigation and are rolling back the hash change where needed. Message: "We've identified a prefix-hash rollout that reduced cache hit rates; we've routed traffic to a stable layout and are warming caches. Expect reduced stalls in ~15-30m." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Runbook step 3 (rollback candidate) in progress. Escalation threshold 30m.

ben (Infra): Rolling back prefix-hash v3 on two remaining clusters. Command used:

infractl rollout abort --change prefix-hash-v3 --clusters eu-west-1,eu-west-2

Rollback in progress; ETA ~8m per cluster.

asha (SRE): Observed cache-hit rate on canary increase from 42% -> 78% after rollback on cluster eu-west-1. p95 ~210ms, p99 ~420ms. Good.

carla (ML Infra): Streaming tail latency stalling traces show remaining latencies from origin pulls for very large context sessions — will add targeted prefetch and retry suppression for those flows.

jordan (oncall): Handing off to night oncall in 40m. Current state: primary mitigation applied, rollback complete on 2/3 clusters, routing override live, warmup running. Customer impact: transient increased latency and streaming stalls for ~20-50% of sessions during rollout window. No data loss.

ops-support: Logged impacted customers and ticket IDs: #INC-7421, #INC-7424. CS drafts sent.

asha (SRE): Next steps: full rollback to be completed on all clusters, continue warmup for 60m, follow-up postmortem to include hash function analysis and adding automatic rollback criteria when cache-miss delta > 15% in 5m window.

carla (ML Infra): Adding an emergency metric to alert on "prefix-cache-hit-drop" and a gate in the rollout pipeline that fails if local shard hit-rate drops more than 12% within 10m.

jordan (oncall): Handoff: @next_oncall — please monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall traces. I've added runbook links and current playbook in the thread. TL;DR: routing override active, warmup running, rollback ongoing, customer comms in place.

next_oncall: Acked and watching. I'll take full ownership at 2072513400.

incident-bot: Incident 2072509999 updated: status -> mitigated, severity downgraded to SEV2. Timeline recorded. Please add notes for postmortem.

asha (SRE): Closing live mitigation — will prepare incident writeup. Key action items for postmortem:
- root cause: prefix-hash v3 increased key dispersion for short prefixes causing low local cache occupancy
- missing guard: no automatic rollback on cache-miss deltas
- remediation: rollout gate, alert metric, prewarm option in deploy

jordan (oncall): Handoff complete. Last observed p99 ~380ms, p95 ~190ms. Marking thread for postmortem.

ops-support: Final customer update posted to affected customers and status page updated. :white_check_mark:

carla (ML Infra): Attaching representative trace snippets and logs to the postmortem doc.

asha (SRE): Thanks team. Follow-up doc draft in docs/incidents/2072509999-postmortem.md. Will ping for review tomorrow.
